plan.title: Edit Evaluation Time Rejects Non-Numeric Time

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test configuration.
Allow the live-event configuration required by the scenario.
Open the RFQ stage referenced by the case.
Navigate to the Responses tab before opening Settings.
Open the Edit Evaluation Time window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Attempt to enter the case's non-numeric time value in the custom end-time field.
Submit the edited evaluation time so the application can report its response.
Assert that the invalid non-numeric time input is refused with an application error.
